---
title: "Ask a question"
subtitle: "Anything from the reading — a word, a passage, an idea"
toc: false
---

::: {.lead}
You are not expected to understand everything we read. If something in the paragraphs puzzled
you, send it here and we can take it up together in the session.
:::

Your name is optional. Ask anonymously if you would rather.

```{=html}
<!-- ==========================================================================
     SETUP: replace YOUR_FORM_ID below with the id from your Formspree form.
     Create a form at https://formspree.io, and it will give you an endpoint
     like https://formspree.io/f/xayzwbqd — the part after /f/ is the id.
     It appears once, in the action attribute on the next line.
     ========================================================================== -->
<form id="ask-form" class="ask-form"
      action="https://formspree.io/f/YOUR_FORM_ID"
      method="POST">

  <div class="field">
    <label for="ask-name">Your name <span class="opt">optional</span></label>
    <input type="text" id="ask-name" name="name" autocomplete="name"
           placeholder="Leave blank to ask anonymously">
  </div>

  <div class="field">
    <label for="ask-ref">Week or paragraphs <span class="opt">optional</span></label>
    <input type="text" id="ask-ref" name="reference"
           placeholder="e.g. Week 3, or paragraph 27">
  </div>

  <div class="field">
    <label for="ask-q">Your question</label>
    <textarea id="ask-q" name="question" rows="6" required
              placeholder="What would you like to ask?"></textarea>
  </div>

  <!-- Honeypot: bots fill hidden fields, people do not. -->
  <input type="text" name="_gotcha" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true"
         style="position:absolute;left:-9999px;opacity:0">

  <input type="hidden" name="_subject" value="Iqán study — a question">

  <button type="submit" class="btn-slides primary">Send question</button>

  <p class="form-status" id="ask-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
</form>

<script>
(function () {
  var form   = document.getElementById('ask-form');
  var status = document.getElementById('ask-status');
  if (!form) return;

  // Without this script the form still posts normally to Formspree and lands
  // on their confirmation page. With it, submission happens in place so the
  // reader never leaves the site.
  form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
    event.preventDefault();

    // Until the Formspree id is filled in, say so rather than posting to an
    // endpoint that does not exist.
    if (form.action.indexOf('YOUR_FORM_ID') !== -1) {
      status.className = 'form-status err';
      status.textContent =
        'This form is not connected yet. Please send your question to me directly for now.';
      return;
    }

    var button = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
    button.disabled = true;
    status.className = 'form-status';
    status.textContent = 'Sending…';

    fetch(form.action, {
      method:  'POST',
      body:    new FormData(form),
      headers: { Accept: 'application/json' }
    }).then(function (response) {
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Request failed');
      form.reset();
      status.className = 'form-status ok';
      status.textContent = 'Thank you — your question has been sent.';
    }).catch(function () {
      status.className = 'form-status err';
      status.textContent =
        'Something went wrong sending that. Please try again, or send it to me directly.';
    }).finally(function () {
      button.disabled = false;
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```

::: {.source-note}
Questions come straight to me. Nothing you send appears on this site unless we decide together
to bring it into a session handout.
:::
